entries.title: Wintergrasp
body: A high plateau overlooking the Dragonblight and the Borean Tundra, undisturbed for ages, its icy winds howling unheard among ancient titan fortifications. It was once a vast lake, Lake Wintergrasp; the lake has shrunk, leaving its basin open.
Its wealth of elemental materials, its titan fortifications, and the rumours of an ancient vault beneath its keep have made it the prize of a vicious tug-of-war between the Horde and the Alliance.

entries.title: Wintergrasp Fortress
body: A titan fortress of two walls, with domed watchtowers, guarding the entrance to the Vault of Archavon. Whoever holds it holds the way into the vault.

entries.title: The Towers and Workshops
body: Towers and old titan ruins across the plateau, where the factions build their siege engines and fight to cut off each other's attack on the fortress.

entries.title: The Wilds of Wintergrasp
body: Beyond the battle lines, the plateau holds pools of fire, frozen bogs and dark forests, each rich in the elemental materials both armies covet.
